logp.method_description: The partition coefficient (log Po/w) of Pt complex and oxaliplatin was calculated by using the shake-flask procedure in a mixed octanol-water medium according method reported in Ref [26] by using the equation of . For this purpose, 200 μL of Pt agent dissolved in water and an equal amount of octanol were stirred overnight, and then centrifuged to analyze the amount of Pt metal using the ICP technique.
